# Reloop

> Reloop is high-performance, open-source email infrastructure for developers—transactional and marketing email, SMTP, webhooks, analytics, and agent-ready APIs. Use Reloop hosted or self-host.

Important notes:

- Authentication uses the `x-api-key` header with API keys prefixed with `rl_`
- Prefer markdown: append `.md` where available (blog, pricing, docs)
- Product documentation lives under `/docs` with its own [docs/llms.txt](https://reloop.sh/docs/llms.txt)

## Agent discovery

- [Full marketing corpus](https://reloop.sh/llms-full.txt): Home, pricing, agent pages, and blog in one file
- [Product docs full corpus](https://reloop.sh/docs/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation snapshot
- [Sitemap (markdown)](https://reloop.sh/sitemap.md): All public marketing URLs
- [Product skill](https://reloop.sh/skill.md): Capabilities, auth, constraints for agents
- [Pricing (markdown)](https://reloop.sh/pricing.md): Structured plan and price data
- [Site MCP](https://reloop.sh/mcp): Search marketing content
- [Docs MCP](https://reloop.sh/docs/mcp): Search product documentation
- [MCP discovery](https://reloop.sh/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable MCP location
